corrections.reason: The description asks kids to use decision steps to pick safe choices, but no listed prerequisite teaches those steps. g4-hlth-safe-decisions is the direct source of the decision process, and no other listed prerequisite depends on it, so it is a needed, direct addition.

output.notes: Reviewed all ten Grade 6 skills. Only g6-hlth-drug-choices is missing a direct prerequisite (g4-hlth-safe-decisions for the decision steps). The other skills' prerequisites are real and direct, or their needed earlier ideas (for example g1-hlth-body-cues, g1-hlth-thoughts-feelings, g2-hlth-food-allergies, g3-hlth-cultural-foods) are already reached through listed prerequisites, so adding them would break the directness rule. Titles and descriptions are clear and read-aloud friendly, and no prerequisite points to a later grade or to the skill itself.
